primary.contrast: selected method minus its baseline; screening ce_cf minus ce
primary.correction: fixed sequence at alpha 0.05; second test confirmatory only after first passes; other intervals descriptive
primary.conditional_success: positive lower 95% paired-panel bootstrap bound for crossed joint accuracy AND nonnegative crossed cell difference
primary.task_solving_success: conditional_success AND positive lower 95% paired bootstrap bound for ordinary Hit@1 AND nonnegative ordinary Hit@8 and correct-mass differences
primary.missing_crossed: no START x TARGET claim, including in the nonlinear DSL; report ordinary-domain adaptation separately

queues.Q1: existing 0.6B/8B checkpoints: crossed panels, ordinary tasks, four-TARGET alignment and entropy diagnostics; no training
queues.Q2: historical composition seed0, original mask by default; matching-mask SFT receipts required for reward confirmation on masks1/2
queues.Q3: ce, ce_entropy, ce_cf, ce_cf_entropy; identical task panels, seed, exposure order, operation-token CE and prefix scorer
queues.Q4: plain/state/token-control inference on chosen prefixes; state/SIGReg factorial only after a positive paired dev signal

secondary: crossed per-cell A/B accuracy and four-cell joint accuracy
raw H1/H8 and correct-set mass over all candidates
greedy constrained and unconstrained program execution
state prediction and causal projection ablation

policy.secondary: full-vocabulary program score with global leaf softmax; never pooled with local policy
policy.reward: binary population-standard-deviation advantages, G=32, KL=0; exact expectation before Adam/clipping

data.crossed_train_gate: requested panel count AND >=8 distinct programs; otherwise train four-TARGET assignment loss
data.exclusion: all correct-trajectory states and task identities disjoint from inherited data and across new panels/splits
data.length: new atomic-start continuations train only depth<=3; historical SFT has already seen depth4
data.exposure_scope: witness/supervised correct-program pairs across recorded task-training stages; base pretraining is unknown; enumerated scoring prefixes are not withheld

gates.reward: kernel enumeration; MC enough informative groups and 4-SE agreement, bounded 128/512/2048-group diagnosis; inconclusive rare reward is distinct from failure; isolated FP32/BF16 Adam and Taylor checks
gates.state: paired dev gain of true-current-state over BOTH plain and token-matched control, positive lower 95% panel bootstrap bound
gates.confirmation: explicit dev selection artifact; exactly baseline plus one selected method, masks1/2 and paired seeds0/1/2
gates.external: shared atomic PLAN/APPLY warm-up on train fields only, per-operation dev accuracy >=0.8 with >=20 tasks/op; then paired method continuation from that same adapter

statistics.unit: whole crossed/four-TARGET panels; ordinary tasks clustered by (field, START); paired arms, seeds averaged first; stratified B/D and masks
statistics.masks: report separately and equal mean; tasks do not replace independent masks
statistics.initialization: Q3/Q4: shared inherited atomic base; Q2 masks: matching-mask SFT adapter from that base; paired arms share initialization within each mask; continuation seeds are not independent full training replications

final: new immutable v4 lock binds endpoint hierarchy, plan/code/data/selection and completed training cells; v2/v3 unchanged

sigreg.definition: random unit projections and Gaussian-weighted empirical-characteristic-function distance to N(0,1)
sigreg.duplicates: one mean representation per exact (field, dimension, state) within batch
sigreg.interpretation: regularization of compact state projection; no imported LeJEPA guarantees

budget_curve.scope: explicit dev stage only; separate same-initialization runs; negative small-pilot results are inconclusive

mc_diagnostic.training_rows: manifest.training_panels; same pool as reward pilot

matching_mask_sft.activation: explicit --prepare-matching-sft, or verified reward_initializations per mask in model profile
matching_mask_sft.initialization: inherited atomic base, no historical composition adapter
matching_mask_sft.cost: two shared SFT initialization runs before twelve reward continuations in confirmation
matching_mask_sft.exposure: recorded task-training pairs must exclude the target mask at every stage
